diagnosis: The internal directory profile endpoint fetches user profiles by primary key. A Sequelize afterFind hook attaches departmental badges and internal group designations. The endpoint does not verify that the profile belongs to the caller's enterprise organization, allowing users to inspect internal organizational structures and departmental designations of external companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/directory/profiles/prof_defense_contractor_exec HTTP/1.1
Host: directory.portal.com:8110
Authorization: Bearer <contractor_guest_jwt>
